name: Dotfiles
description: A zsh setup that reconfigures itself: modules declare their own priority, dependencies and flags in comments, and a loader parses them. No config, a small framework.

name: Tanoshi Multiplatform
description: A Kotlin Multiplatform anime/manga reader where the desktop app reimplements Android's own Activity lifecycle from scratch, and extensions are sandboxed plugins with off-by-default permissions.
